subject: Re: Stratify — counteroffer & runtime compatibility

From: Evan Morris <evan@stratify.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Stratify — exploring parity + migration costs

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the product overview last week. We're under a tight cadence to lock economics for a Q2 rollout and I wanted to surface what we're seeing on the market and get your appetite for matching.

Context: One of the vendors (named vendor) submitted a commercial that is ~30% lower on per-token runtime pricing and is offering a short onboarding stipend + managed migration support to accelerate cutover. The team is nervous about runtime compatibility (quantization, KV cache persistence, latency at 512+ token sequences) and wants a clear migration path, but economics are leaning the other way.

Can Redwood match the headline unit economics or offer an equivalent package (credits + migration hours)? If not, can you map where the delta is and what tradeoffs we should expect (performance vs cost, expected engineering time for integration)?

We'd like:
- Headline matched pricing or a firm counter within 72 hours
- A short Mutual Action Plan with milestones and SRE-hours estimate
- A technical note on model compatibility and any runtime limitations we should plan for

If you can send a short counter + attachments I can route to procurement. Timeline is end of Feb for vendor decision.

Best,
Evan Morris
Head of AI, Stratify
Evan.Morris@stratify.com

[Attachment: vendor-commercial-summary.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Evan Morris <evan@stratify.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 12:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stratify — exploring parity + migration costs

Evan — thanks for the clear ask and context. We can be pragmatic here. High level: we can match the headline unit price for an initial commitment window paired with an onboarding credit and a dedicated migration scope. Details below and attached.

Quick counter (summary):
- Headline: match competitor per-token rate for the first 6 months after go-live, conditional on a 12-month commitment thereafter.
- Onboarding credit: $60,000 applied against first invoice (covers migration run-hours & initial ramp).
- Migration support: 120 SRE hours dedicated + 2-week canary pilot with runtime monitoring (we'll provide KV cache migration patterns and prefix caching guidance).
- Technical caveats: quantized models with >6-bit aggressive quantization may require a small perf delta; we'll document expected latency implications for 512+ token sequences in the attached compatibility note.
- Deliverables: mutual-action-plan.docx, technical-compatibility memo (attached), migration cost workbook (attached).

Next steps:
1) Marcus — can you confirm the SRE hours estimate looks right and flag any likely blockers?
2) Jordan — commercial approve the credit + commitment trade (I asked for a 12-month minimum).
3) Evan — if that sounds acceptable, let's schedule a 45-min tech + procurement sync. Calendar link: https://calendly.com/redwood/stratify-sync

I've attached: redwood-compatibility-note.pdf, transition-costs.xlsx, mutual-action-plan.docx.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachments: redwood-compatibility-note.pdf (PDF), transition-costs.xlsx (XLSX), mutual-action-plan.docx (DOCX)]

Evan — thanks for the patience while we aligned internally. Short version: we can meet you in the middle.

Final commercial offer:
- Redwood will match the competitor's per-token runtime rate for the first 6 months after go-live.
- Onboarding credit: $50,000 applied up-front on month 1 invoice.
- Migration support: 100 dedicated SRE hours + 2-week canary with active monitoring and rollback playbook. Additional hours billed at standard T&M.
- Commitment: 12-month term with an option to renew; if the customer scales >2x forecast in the first 3 months, we'll revisit routing policies and provide a 30-day ramp consultation.

I've attached the mutual-action-plan.docx link and a DocuSign term sheet to formalize. Please review the scope bullets below and sign the DocuSign if acceptable: https://docusign.com/reds/GR8-abc123

Technical note: Marcus confirms the 100-hour plan covers model conversion and a standard KV migration pattern. If your models require custom kernel work (edge quantization beyond our tested profiles) we'll surface an incremental estimate during the tech sync.
